title: [GMCP 203.026.05] Interoperability and quality: OAuth-capable MCP client and authorization flow
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-026-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: The host completes secure authorization-code flows with PKCE, state and nonce binding, protected-resource discovery, authorization-server selection, exact redirect matching, refresh rotation, revocation, incremental scopes and per-resource credential binding. Dynamic registration is isolated as legacy policy; current client metadata mechanisms, loopback hardening, browser cancellation and concurrent-account flows are interoperable and attack-tested. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
